verdict.rationale: The only support is customer testimonials on Sakana's own page saying Marlin's reports are grounded in primary rather than secondary sources. The documented workflow itself describes only "navigating the web," with no named scholarly databases or academic search. Missing for 10: documented access to scholarly literature or academic databases (e.g. journals, preprints, citation indexes), first-party description of how primary sources are retrieved beyond open-web navigation, independent or hands-on corroboration of source quality.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web

citations.quote: 二次情報ではなく一次情報を参照できている点に優位性を感じました
